highlights: Major AI providers are accelerating innovation with new model releases and strategic integrations; OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra features a 20% API price drop, while Google is leveraging Gemini 4 Hydrogen for an upgraded Search experience.

The 'agentic AI' ecosystem is rapidly maturing, with advancements like Anthropic's Claude gaining complex tool-chaining capabilities, Perplexity introducing multi-agent systems for enhanced problem-solving, and foundational research proposing architectures for a truly portable Agent-Native Web.

Significant developments in AI infrastructure and model self-improvement are emerging, highlighted by NVIDIA open-sourcing tools for managed Kubernetes on GPU infrastructure and groundbreaking research into language models capable of rewriting their own weights without traditional retraining.

agents.title: Perplexity Computer Adds Multiagent with Cross-Checking
agents.summary: Perplexity has enhanced its Computer feature with a Multiagent system, allowing a lead agent to coordinate up to 16 AI agents across various models to share findings and cross-check work, significantly improving complex task execution.

agents.title: Anthropic Adds Code Mode to Claude for Chained JavaScript Tool Calls
agents.summary: Anthropic's Claude Code v2.1.323 now features an experimental Code Mode, enabling Claude to write JavaScript that chains Bash, Read, and Edit calls in a single step, enhancing its ability to interact programmatically and keep talking during long commands.

agents.title: WebAgents Unbundles Agent Creation, Hosting, and Execution for Agent-Native Web
agents.summary: A new framework, WebAgents, unbundles the lifecycle of AI agents by using signed agent.pkg files for portable workflows, skills, and resource requirements, allowing user-controlled models and tools to bind at runtime, fostering a secure and interoperable Agentic Web.

models.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with 20% Cheaper Astra API
models.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, delivering improved professional outputs, coding, and computer usage, with Astra's API price reduced by 20% to $8/$40 per million tokens, making frontier AI more accessible and efficient for developers.

models.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights for Self-Improvement
models.summary: Groundbreaking research shows a 27B language model can diagnose failures and edit its own weights without gradients or traditional training, leading to persistent accuracy gains on unseen problems and even repairing damaged copies, suggesting a new paradigm for model improvement through 'conversation' rather than training runs.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra Omnimodal Decision Models
models.summary: Liquid AI has introduced d1.2 and d1.2-ultra, new omnimodal decision models that process text, images, and audio to return calibrated probabilities with zero output tokens, topping the AA Decision Index and offering enhanced decision-making capabilities.

tools.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources NVKE and NVKR for Managed Kubernetes on GPU Infrastructure
tools.summary: NVIDIA has open-sourced NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) and NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes (NVKR) under Apache 2.0, enabling AI factories to run managed Kubernetes services on their own bare-metal GPU servers, simplifying infrastructure management for AI workloads.

tools.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 Released, Strengthening Local AI Ecosystem
tools.summary: llama.cpp has released its v1.0.0, establishing a stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem by enhancing the capability to run large language models efficiently on consumer hardware, a crucial development for accessible and private AI applications.

tools.title: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API for Fast Multimodal Decisions
tools.summary: Google has introduced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by its state-of-the-art Gemini Decision model, designed to deliver fast, calibrated multimodal decisions, providing developers with a powerful new tool for integrating advanced decision-making into their applications.

companies.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol and Cuts Astra API Price by 20%
companies.summary: OpenAI's launch of GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, alongside a 20% reduction in Astra's API pricing, reinforces its market position by offering enhanced, more cost-effective frontier models for various applications including ChatGPT Work, Codex, and API integrations.

companies.title: Google Search Gets Major Upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
companies.summary: Google is globally upgrading its Search product with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, promising more helpful, visual, and intuitive responses, showcasing the integration of frontier AI models into core consumer services and advancing search intelligence.

companies.title: Google and Adobe Partner to Integrate Creative & Productivity Tools
companies.summary: Google and Adobe are deepening their partnership by integrating Adobe's creative and productivity tools, including Adobe AI, directly into Google apps and Gemini, streamlining workflows and expanding AI-powered capabilities for users across both ecosystems.

learning.title: Guide Explains AI Data Retention: Two Standard API Designs
learning.summary: A new guide clarifies the complexities of AI data retention by explaining two standard API designs, outlining who manages data deletion in each, and offering six critical checks for developers to ensure compliance and privacy in their AI applications.

learning.title: SkillBuffBench: New Benchmark for Agent Skill Evaluation
learning.summary: SkillBuffBench introduces a new benchmark and evaluation protocol to measure the contribution of agent skills across various harnesses, models, skill access modes, and memory configurations, providing crucial insights for developers building and optimizing AI agents.

learning.title: OpenAI Broadens Free Access to Frontier AI for 200,000 Scientists
learning.summary: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to offer 200,000 scientists worldwide free access to its frontier models, democratizing advanced AI tools for scientific discovery and fostering global research innovation.
